reviewer: JOB3 native worker author reviewing host code only
scope: Independent source-only cross-review of C++ host/plugin and package dependency changes; no review approval for author-owned Rust changes.

checks.result: New check() forwards through existing impl::execute, native_exchange and spawn/reaper/discard paths; no independent runtime/process owner. Empty peer async_close is safe according to transport::stream implementation.
check shares existing id uniqueness, max_active/max_queued, stop-token callback, cancellation, deadline and shutdown accounting. Lazy awaitable captures impl rather than raw engine lifetime.

FTN1 selected for ordinary empty policy; FTN2 fields match agreed layout. Terminal metadata/disclosure/commitment masks, directions, algorithm, reserved bytes, lengths, indices and opening ownership are checked before returned data is exposed.

Plugin delegates moved requests with no duplicate DTO family or aliases. engine prove/verify/check extract only id, stop_token and deadline before moving request; execute owns those scalar/control values instead of copying nested session_options selections.
Public types import crypto_core/digest, CMake public links match, ForgeConfig recursively adds both components, and existing OpenSSL discovery includes those components.
engine/check comments and README correctly require caller-authenticated full evidence+context. Offline opening check does not claim imported origin/metadata authenticity or a notarized TLS proof.

Re-read execute declaration/definition and all three caller sites after refactor. id and stop_token are captured before move; queue identity and cancellation semantics are preserved. No dangling reference or use of moved request was found.

nonblocking_observations.detail: END selection admission counts the configured transcript maximum while the worker uses actual length. This is conservative bounded admission and may reject multiple END selections whose actual total would fit; clarify this upper-bound behavior in API documentation if relevant.
nonblocking_observations.resolution: Documented in libraries/net/tlsnotary/README.md:74-76. No outstanding change requested.
